thread:
Priya Nair: Quick pitch: move to an "ephemeral inspect" model — default scrub full bodies, keep 30d hashed headers/meta, allow short-lived inspect tokens for sampled payloads. Aim: cut storage and PII surface while keeping on-call debug flow.
Sam Ortiz: Sounds good. How do we pick which payloads get full bodies? random, deterministic, or cue-based?
Priya Nair: Proposal: deterministic hash(tenant_id, request_id, salt) -> choose 0.5% by default. Increase to 100% for tenants flagged by anomaly detector for 1 hour.
Jordan Li: UX: console needs clear state: REDACTED / INSPECTABLE / FULL. Show reason code and expiration for inspect tokens.
Alex Chen: Also require per-tenant salted hash so two tenants can't correlate selection. salt rotates monthly.
Maya Patel: Breakglass: short-lived tokens issued via SSO with approval reason. Audit event must include approver, justification, TTL, and affected tenant.
ops-bot: Note: breakglass.audit emitted on token use with fields [user, approver_id, tenant, token_id, reason_code]. No payload attached.
Priya Nair: Telemetry: emit metrics only (no text): payload_sampled_total, payload_sample_rate, payload_error_sample_bias. Dashboards use these aggregates.
Sam Ortiz: Implementation note: run sampling at the mux/proxy before persisting payload. If selected, route copy to encrypted short-term store with TTL 7 days. Hash metadata stored 30d.
Priya Nair: Config draft (YAML):
```yaml
sampling:
  default_rate: 0.005
  anomaly_boost_window_s: 3600
  min_per_tenant_per_day: 1
  inspect_ttl_days: 7
  metadata_hash_days: 30
  file_size_cutoff_bytes: 16384
```
Jordan Li: File-size cutoff: good call. For mobile SDKs that inline binaries we'll scrub and store only size/filename.
Maya Patel: Legal: tenant override only with documented consent. Support can request a temporary special-scope token but must include consent link/attachment in audit record.
Alex Chen: Can we make sampling deterministic so reproducing a debug trace is possible? But ensure salt + tenant-scoped seed.
Sam Ortiz: Yes. Use HMAC_SHA256(tenant_salt, tenant_id||request_id) mod 1e6 < threshold. Implement in mux in Rust for perf.
Priya Nair: Canary plan: enable for 5% of tenants in staging, monitor cost, SLA impact, and PII alerts for 72h, then 25% for 48h, then GA.
Jordan Li: Console UX: show a subtle banner on routes using sampling and an explicit tooltip explaining 'why body not visible'. Also provide counts: inspected_last_7d, inspected_rate.
Maya Patel: Ops: add an emergency off switch at infra level to set default_rate=0 immediately.
ops-bot: FYI: deploy policy requires feature-flag + infra-gate. Off switch will be `infra.toggle.payload_sampling=false`.
Priya Nair: Edge cases: embeddings -> never store raw vectors. Obfuscate at vector-ingest and mark as pseudonymized. Attach to RFC.
Sam Ortiz: Attachments >16KB are truncated and replaced with metadata; include sha256 of original only for dedupe, not for debugging.
Alex Chen: Action items: Priya write metrics list + RFC, Sam prototype mux HMAC sampler, Jordan mock UI banners and tooltips, Maya coordinate legal/sso breakglass.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: payload-sampling-canary -> 2026-03-24T04:00:00Z to canary-5pct
Priya Nair: I'll open the RFC and include sample queries for dashboards. Comments welcome here.
Jordan Li: minor: include a column in trace list showing `inspect_state` with link to request inspect flow (if permitted).
Priya Nair: noted, thanks.
